documentPreparation.title: Prepare PDFs with MinerU
documentPreparation.help:
Use MinerU official cloud. Confirmation uploads uncached PDFs only; up to 200 files, 200 MB / 200 pages each, with at most two concurrent uploads or downloads.
Closing this panel keeps work running. Stop only cancels local waiting; uploaded remote tasks may continue. Reopen to resume or retry. A new batch replaces task records and retains attachment caches.

documentPreparation.limit: At most 200 PDFs per batch; narrow the selection

documentPreparation.failure.timeout: Timed out; the remote task may continue. Resume to query it.
